1JN.c1.article.freedom-from-guilt.title: Freedom from Guilt
1JN.c1.article.freedom-from-guilt.text: Freedom from Guilt No one likes to feel guilty. Like an unwelcome guest, guilt shows up at the worst possible time and does not go away no matter how much you wish it would. Yet the truth is that we need guilt. It is the only proper response to any offense, whether a selfish thought or a premeditated murder. Even a nonbeliever wants a burglar to feel remorse for his theft. Why? Because he should.
